subject: reasoning
question:
Six friends, Priya, Arun, Vansh, Rajat, Bhavna and Manju, are sitting around a circular table, with their backs towards the centre. Vansh is sitting second to the right of Rajat. Arun and Priya are not the neighbours of Rajat. Manju is sitting between Rajat and Arun.

Who is sitting between Vansh and Rajat?
solution:
Six friends, Priya, Arun, Vansh, Rajat, Bhavna and Manju, are sitting around a circular table, with their backs towards the centre.

1) Vansh is sitting second to the right of Rajat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d32a73a6bdf389651b2ed92726e185680f812ba9675bbc022b2d584f718b1c6.png] 

2) Manju is sitting between Rajat and Arun.&l
